blockers: Explicit inspected Boltz/Python/source, checkpoint and complete pre-staged cache pins
Local hashed A3M files with sequence-matched queries and generation provenance for required sequences
Template coordinate files matching imported source SHA-256 and byte counts
Actual template-chain selections and parsed residue-alignment evidence for each template-enabled job

comparison_limit: Accession matching does not establish identical template features, MSAs or paired random seeds across AF3 and Boltz.
